#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>

using namespace std;

const int ALPHABET_SIZE = 26;
const int INF = 0x3f3f3f3f;

struct Edge {
    int v, cap, cost, next;
    Edge(int _v, int _cap, int _cost, int _next) : v(_v), cap(_cap), cost(_cost), next(_next) {}
};

int minCostMaxFlow(vector<vector<int>>& adj, vector<Edge>& to, int edgeCount, int totalNodes, int src, int dst) {
    vector<int> potential(totalNodes, INF);
    potential[src] = 0;
    
    // Bellman-Ford for initial potential
    for (int iter = 0; iter < totalNodes; iter++) {
        for (int u = 0; u < totalNodes; u++) {
            if (potential[u] == INF) continue;
            for (int i = 1; i <= adj[u][0]; i++) {
                int e = adj[u][i];
                int v = to[e].v, cap = to[e].cap, cost = to[e].cost;
                if (cap > 0 && potential[u] + cost < potential[v]) {
                    potential[v] = potential[u] + cost;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    int totalCost = 0;
    
    while (true) {
        vector<int> dist(totalNodes, INF);
        vector<int> prevNode(totalNodes);
        vector<int> prevEdge(totalNodes);
        dist[src] = 0;
        
        priority_queue<pair<int, int>, vector<pair<int, int>>, greater<pair<int, int>>> pq;
        pq.push({0, src});
        vector<bool> visited(totalNodes, false);
        
        while (!pq.empty()) {
            auto cur = pq.top();
            pq.pop();
            int d = cur.first, u = cur.second;
            if (visited[u]) continue;
            visited[u] = true;
            
            for (int i = 1; i <= adj[u][0]; i++) {
                int e = adj[u][i];
                int v = to[e].v, cap = to[e].cap, cost = to[e].cost;
                if (cap > 0 && dist[u] + cost + potential[u] - potential[v] < dist[v]) {
                    dist[v] = dist[u] + cost + potential[u] - potential[v];
                    prevNode[v] = u;
                    prevEdge[v] = e;
                    pq.push({dist[v], v});
                }
            }
        }
        
        if (dist[dst] == INF) break;
        
        for (int i = 0; i < totalNodes; i++) {
            if (dist[i] < INF) potential[i] += dist[i];
        }
        
        int f = INF;
        for (int v = dst; v != src; v = prevNode[v]) {
            int e = prevEdge[v];
            f = min(f, to[e].cap);
        }
        
        for (int v = dst; v != src; v = prevNode[v]) {
            int e = prevEdge[v];
            to[e].cap -= f;
            to[e ^ 1].cap += f;
            totalCost += f * to[e].cost;
        }
    }
    
    return totalCost;
}

void addEdge(vector<vector<int>>& adj, vector<Edge>& to, int& edgeCount, int u, int v, int cap, int cost) {
    int edgeIdx = edgeCount * 2;
    to[edgeIdx] = Edge(v, cap, cost, adj[u][0]);
    if (adj[u].size() > adj[u][0] + 1) {
        adj[u][adj[u][0] + 1] = edgeIdx;
    }
    adj[u][0]++;
    
    edgeIdx++;
    to[edgeIdx] = Edge(u, 0, -cost, adj[v][0]);
    if (adj[v].size() > adj[v][0] + 1) {
        adj[v][adj[v][0] + 1] = edgeIdx;
    }
    adj[v][0]++;
    
    edgeCount++;
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    n /= 2;
    
    string s;
    cin >> s;
    
    vector<int> values(n * 2);
    for (int i = 0; i < n * 2; i++) {
        cin >> values[i];
    }
    
    int totalNodes = 1 + n + ALPHABET_SIZE + 1;
    
    vector<vector<int>> adj(totalNodes, vector<int>(ALPHABET_SIZE * 2 + 5, 0));
    vector<Edge> to(totalNodes * ALPHABET_SIZE * 2);
    int edgeCount = 0;
    
    // Connect source to positions
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        addEdge(adj, to, edgeCount, 0, 1 + i, 2, 0);
    }
    
    // Connect positions to letters
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int j = n * 2 - 1 - i;
        int ci = s[i] - 'a';
        int cj = s[j] - 'a';
        
        for (int letter = 0; letter < ALPHABET_SIZE; letter++) {
            int val;
            if (letter == ci && letter == cj) {
                val = max(values[i], values[j]);
            } else if (letter == ci) {
                val = values[i];
            } else if (letter == cj) {
                val = values[j];
            } else {
                val = 0;
            }
            addEdge(adj, to, edgeCount, 1 + i, 1 + n + letter, 1, -val);
        }
    }
    
    vector<int> letterCounts(ALPHABET_SIZE, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < n * 2; i++) {
        int ch = s[i] - 'a';
        letterCounts[ch]++;
    }
    
    for (int letter = 0; letter < ALPHABET_SIZE; letter++) {
        addEdge(adj, to, edgeCount, 1 + n + letter, totalNodes - 1, letterCounts[letter], 0);
    }
    
    int result = minCostMaxFlow(adj, to, edgeCount, totalNodes, 0, totalNodes - 1);
    cout << -result << endl;
    
    return 0;
}
